onboarding.supportBody: If you’d like to help more people discover the project, open the repository to leave a star or follow the creator on X.
onboarding.socialPrivacy: Persona Voice can confirm that each page opened, but never reads your GitHub or X account.
onboarding.engineTitle: Install the engine that changes the voice.
onboarding.engineBody: The launcher stays small. Seed-VC, managed Python, and seven pinned model files are installed separately into private app storage.
onboarding.verifiedBeforeUse: Revisions and SHA-256 verified before use
onboarding.engineTerms: Installation uses the network and can be cancelled or resumed. Seed-VC is GPL-3.0; downloaded model artifacts retain their upstream terms.
onboarding.setupLaterHint: You can install it later from Settings → Voice.

platformAudio.linuxTitle: Set up the guarded Linux audio route.
platformAudio.linuxBody: Persona Voice installs one owned per-user PipeWire/WirePlumber policy for ChatGPT and Codex. It never replaces unmanaged policy files.
platformAudio.linuxRestartFact: Restarts your user audio session once; the app stays open
platformAudio.windowsBody: Persona Voice uses the signed VB-CABLE driver from VB-Audio. It is installed separately and is never bundled with the Persona Voice installer.
platformAudio.windowsDownloadStep: Download VB-CABLE, run its setup as administrator, then restart Windows.
platformAudio.windowsOpenAppStep: Open ChatGPT or Codex and start voice or audio playback.
platformAudio.windowsAssignStep: In Windows Volume Mixer, set that app’s Output to CABLE Input.
platformAudio.windowsVerifyStep: Return here and verify the live route.
platformAudio.readyHint: The guarded system audio route is ready.
platformAudio.setupLaterHint: You can continue, but the relay stays blocked until this route is ready. Finish later in Settings → Application.
platformAudio.settingsBody: Manage the platform-owned route that prevents original and converted speech from playing together.
platformAudio.bridgeUnavailable: The desktop platform-audio bridge is unavailable.
platformAudio.linuxSettingsNotice: Installing or removing the route restarts the current PipeWire/WirePlumber user audio session. Playback pauses briefly; Persona Voice does not restart.
platformAudio.windowsSettingsNotice: VB-CABLE is third-party software installed from VB-Audio. Restore each app’s Output to Default in Volume Mixer before uninstalling VB-CABLE.

home.armedDetail: Open voice mode in ChatGPT or Codex. The original route stays untouched until the conversation is connected.
home.runningDetail: Realtime audio is being converted to {voice}.
home.startingDetail: Loading and warming the local voice engine. You can cancel safely while it prepares.
home.stoppingDetail: Closing conversion first, then restoring the original application audio route.
home.faultedDetail: Converted playback stopped. Restore the original audio route before trying again.
home.readyDetail: Start once, then use voice mode normally. Conversion and history stay on this device.
home.blockedDetailOne: {count} check needs attention before the relay can start.
home.blockedDetailOther: {count} checks need attention before the relay can start.
home.title: Realtime voice, in the voice you choose.
home.intro: Persona Voice converts assistant speech locally and plays the selected target voice through a guarded process-scoped route.
home.currentRouteBody: What Persona Voice will capture and play.
home.systemBlocked: The relay fails closed when a stage is missing.

history.title: History
history.intro: Only converted output is saved. Source audio is never written to disk.
history.emptyEnabled: Converted clips appear here after a voice session and are deleted {retention}.
history.emptyDisabled: Enable Save converted audio in Settings to keep local clips.

confirmClear.title: Clear audio history?
confirmClear.bodyOne: This permanently removes {count} converted clip from this device.
confirmClear.bodyOther: This permanently removes {count} converted clips from this device.

audio.unavailableTitle: Transparent relay is not available on this system
audio.sourceMethodBody: Persona Voice must own or suppress the original route before it can play converted audio.
audio.desktopBody: Capture ChatGPT or Codex without changing how you use voice mode.
audio.codexBody: Own a Codex realtime PCM stream before hardware playback.
audio.applicationBody: Automatic mode follows matching ChatGPT and Codex process trees.
audio.pinnedSource: Pinned to a stable executable or stream identity.
audio.automaticSource: Uses every matching realtime voice process.
audio.routeGuaranteeBody: Missing capture, suppression, conversion, or output blocks startup.

voice.installedVoicesBody: Preview the original reference, then choose the timbre used by Seed-VC.
voice.engineProfileBody: The current realtime profile is fixed so measured latency remains reproducible.
voice.profileFacts: 300 ms blocks · 10 diffusion steps · 3 s session-start discard
voice.downloadNotice: Downloads managed Python, locked packages, and seven SHA-256 verified model files. Seed-VC is GPL-3.0; model files retain their upstream terms.
voice.creditNotice: Selected voice requires credit {credit}. Bundled character scenes, when present, have separate terms in the third-party notices.

history.localHistoryBody: Only converted frames accepted by the output sink can enter history.
history.saveAudioBody: Store completed converted segments on this device. Raw source audio is never stored.
history.deleteBody: Cleanup runs at launch and every five minutes.
history.clearHistoryBody: Permanently remove every converted clip from the local history directory.
history.localNotice: Inference, voice references, settings, and history remain local while the relay is running.

application.languageBody: Change the language used throughout Persona Voice.
application.launcherBody: Keep the relay close without leaving an unmanaged audio route behind.
application.launchSupported: Open quietly when you sign in.
application.launchUnsupported: Available only in an installed desktop build.
application.keepRunningBody: When the relay is active, closing the window keeps capture and conversion running in the tray.
application.recordingBody: Optional demo routing for capture software.
application.obsBusBody: Mirror converted-only output to BlackHole 2ch. Keep BlackHole out of the macOS default or Multi-Output route.
application.blackHoleNotice: BlackHole is a demo dependency. In OBS, mute audio from macOS Screen Capture to avoid recording the original stream.

diagnostics.capabilityBody: Feasible and implemented are reported separately.
diagnostics.telemetryBody: Local measurements from the current warmed worker. No audio content is logged.
